QuestInfo.name: Carson's Fundamentals of Alchemy
QuestInfo.0: When I visited Moren to learn his new method, he instructed me to attend a class on the Fundamentals of Alchemy taught by Carson of Zenumist Society. Ahhh... this sounds boring...
QuestInfo.1: Moren said in order to attend the class on the Fundamentals of Alchemy, I must visit the head of Zenumist Society, #bCarson#k.
QuestInfo.2: I managed to stay awake for Carson's class on the Fundamentals of Alchemy. Yay!

0.0: The class on fundamentals of alchemy will be taught by #bCarson#k of Zenumist Society! You can find him at the Zenumist Society building at the west end of town, so he should be easy to find!\nAh! The tuition for the class will be #b10,000 mesos#k, paid in advance! Will you sign up for this class?

yes.0: I will notify Carson that you will be on your way! Go see him right now!
